title: voyriella parviflora
intro: Voyriella parviflora, commonly known as Dwarf Voyriella, is a plant species belonging to the family Loranthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues.
